targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(DATEDIFF(HOUR, sqlserver_start_time, GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR) + 'h' AS [Uptime]
FROM sys.dm_os_sys_info;

SELECT CAST(
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN usecounts>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0))*100
    AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS [Cache Hit %]
FROM sys.dm_exec_cached_plans
WHERE objtype IN ('Adhoc','Prepared');

SELECT cntr_value AS [PLE (s)]
FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters
WHERE object_name LIKE '%Buffer Manager%'
AND counter_name = 'Page life expectancy';

panels.description: Top wait types excluding benign waits

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 15 wait_type AS [Wait Type], 
    wait_time_ms AS [Wait ms]
FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats
WHERE wait_type NOT IN (
    'SLEEP_TASK','BROKER_TASK_STOP','SQLTRACE_BUFFER_FLUSH',
    'CLR_AUTO_EVENT','CLR_MANUAL_EVENT','LAZYWRITER_SLEEP',
    'RESOURCE_QUEUE','CHECKPOINT_QUEUE','REQUEST_FOR_DEADLOCK_SEARCH',
    'XE_TIMER_EVENT','BROKER_TO_FLUSH','BROKER_EVENTHANDLER',
    'FT_IFTS_SCHEDULER_IDLE_WAIT','XE_DISPATCHER_WAIT','WAITFOR',
    'HADR_FILESTREAM_IOMGR_IOCOMPLETION','DIRTY_PAGE_POLL',
    'SP_SERVER_DIAGNOSTICS_SLEEP','ONDEMAND_TASK_QUEUE',
    'DISPATCHER_QUEUE_SEMAPHORE','PREEMPTIVE_OS_AUTHENTICATIONOPS',
    'BROKER_RECEIVE_WAITFOR','PREEMPTIVE_XE_GETTARGETSTATE'
) AND wait_time_ms > 0
ORDER BY wait_time_ms DESC;

panels.title: ⏳ Top Wait Types

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    r.session_id AS [Blocked SID],
    r.blocking_session_id AS [Blocker SID],
    r.wait_type AS [Wait Type],
    r.wait_time AS [Wait ms],
    LEFT(st.text, 80) AS [Blocked Query]
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) st
WHERE r.blocking_session_id > 0
ORDER BY r.wait_time DESC;

SELECT 
    SUM(user_objects_alloc_page_count)*8/1024 AS [User Objects MB],
    SUM(internal_objects_alloc_page_count)*8/1024 AS [Internal Objects MB]
FROM sys.dm_db_session_space_usage;

SELECT 
    DB_NAME(database_id) AS [Database],
    CAST(SUM(size)*8.0/1024 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [Total MB]
FROM sys.master_files
WHERE database_id > 4
GROUP BY database_id
ORDER BY [Total MB] DESC;

SELECT TOP 20
    database_name AS [Database],
    backup_start_date AS [Start],
    backup_finish_date AS [Finish],
    CAST(backup_size/1024.0/1024.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [Size MB]
FROM msdb.dbo.backupset
ORDER BY backup_start_date DESC;

SELECT TOP 20 j.name AS [Job], h.run_date AS [Date], h.run_time AS [Time],
    LEFT(h.message,150) AS [Error]
FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j
JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory h ON j.job_id=h.job_id
WHERE h.run_status=0
ORDER BY h.run_date DESC, h.run_time DESC;
